title: NPDev Conversion Hook
description: An operator-authored SQL conversion hook (schema-engine rebuild, Phase 7 -- rule-6 sanctioned destruction): declares which Impact-Report item keys the hook resolves, so ConversionHookRunner can match it against the live schema diff. Validated at GENERATION time by com.npdev.generator.dbconfig.ConversionHookEmitter; a copy of this schema also lives at NPDevGenerator/generator/src/main/resources/schema/conversion-hook.schema.json for classpath access during generation -- keep the two byte-identical.

id.description: Stable identity for this hook. Used as the classpath folder name (db/conversion-hooks/<id>/) and recorded verbatim in npdev_schema_history.

claims.description: Canonical Impact-Report item keys (SchemaDiffItem.itemKey()) this hook resolves. A hook whose claims intersect the live diff's unresolved item-key set is selected; a hook that matches nothing is skipped (INFO, not an error).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this hook does, for operator review.

verifySql.description: Optional read-only SQL statement returning a single row/column count, run after the hook's convert SQL to confirm it did what it claims.

verifyExpect.description: The count verifySql must return. Defaults to 0 (e.g. "no rows left unconverted").

verify.description: STOR-29 (B10 lift, ALL_HITTABLE_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-05.md package P6): a declarative, engine-portable alternative to verifySql/verifyExpect for the common 'no rows left unconverted' shape. Compiled at load time into the equivalent SELECT COUNT(*) via SqlDialect.countWhereNullSql -- a hand-written verifySql travels only as far as the author's own dialect; this does not need to. Mutually exclusive with verifySql (verify wins if both are present on the same hook). `npdev migrate hook-verify` converts the common convertible shape automatically.

concept.description: The table this hook's convert step touches -- the same physical table-name convention `claims` already uses (e.g. "orders"), not a separate DSL concept-name lookup.

where.description: A single portable null-check: '<column> IS NULL' or '<column> IS NOT NULL'. Anything else is not expressible declaratively yet -- use verifySql instead.

expect.description: The count the rendered query must return. Defaults to 0 (e.g. "no rows left unconverted").

javaHook.description: B1 (REAL_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-03, B13): when present, ConversionHookRunner runs this hook as a Java method in the isolated plugin pool instead of a sibling convert.sql -- mutually exclusive with a convert.sql file existing alongside this hook.json. class/method are enough to invoke the already-admitted, already-compiled hook at runtime; the source root that was admitted at generation time is not recorded here (same shape the plugin:java-source runtime manifest already uses).

class.description: The hook's FQCN, admitted through the same bytecode escape-detection a plugin:java-source mount goes through.

method.description: The method ConversionHookRunner invokes, one row batch per call: List<Map<String,Object>> -> List<Map<String,Object>>.
